spans.s:
यूथ यूथ, अस्, अम्, m. n. (usually अम्, n.;
fr. rt. 2. यु), a flock, herd (of birds, animals, &c.);
a bevy, troop, band; a multitude, number, large
quantity; (ई), f. a kind of jasmine (= यूथिका).
—यूथ-ग, अस्, m., N. of a class of gods under
Manu Cākṣuṣa.
—यूथ-नाथ, अस्, m. the lord
of a band, leader of a troop, head of a flock or herd;
a large elephant.
—यूथ-प, अस्, or यूथ-पति,
इस्, m. a keeper or protector of a troop, lord or
captain of a band; the leader of a herd (especially
of elephants), a large elephant.
—यूथपति-सका-
शम्, ind. to the chief of the herd.
—यूथ-परि-
भ्रष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen out or strayed from the
herd.
—यूथ-पशु, उस्, m., N. of a particular tax
or tithe.
—यूथ-पाल, अस्, m. = यूथ-प.
—यू-
थ-भ्रष्ट or यूथ-विभ्रष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, =
यूथ-परिभ्रष्ट above.
—यूथ-मुख्य, अस्,
m. the chief or captain of a troop.
—यूथ-शस्, ind.
in troops or bands, in flocks or herds, gregariously.
—यूथ-हत, अस्, आ, अम्, = यूथ-परिभ्रष्ट.
—यूथाग्रणी (˚थ-अग्˚), ईस्, m. a leader of a band
or troop.
—यूथी-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, &c., to
make or form into a herd, to unite in a flock.
यूथक at the end of an adj. comp. = यूथ.

यूथर, an adj. fr. यूथ, see Gaṇa Aśmādi to
Pāṇ.

यूथिका, f. a kind of jasmine, Jasminum Auricu-
latum; globe-amaranth; Clypea Hernandifolia.

यूथ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. belonging to a herd or
flock; being at the head of the herd; belonging to
a troop or herd of (at the end of a comp.).
